- [MongoDB Atlas for Government](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/llms.txt.md): > Explore MongoDB Atlas for Government, a fully managed cloud database for U.S. federal, state, and local agencies with unique government-specific features.
- [Atlas CLI - (current) (Part 1 of 5)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-1-llms.txt.md): > The Atlas CLI lets you deploy and manage Atlas database deployments from the terminal, with tutorials for getting started, local development, and Docker-based workflows.
